response.answer: Recent advances in GNNs for analog circuit link prediction include the SEAL framework for subgraph learning and the SpiceNetlist dataset with 775 annotated circuits. Netlist Babel Fish uses retrieval-augmented generation for format conversion, enhancing netlist compatibility. These methods improve data scarcity and topological pattern learning in circuit design automation.
